config.criterion: MC-GS ranks 1st of 11 arms on head-masked slice PSNR, shell RMSE and shell edge-gradient RMSE, on both pre and post (6 conditions); rows sorted by combined_rel_margin = min over the 6 conditions of (MCGS-best_other)/|best_other|, signed so positive=ahead -- this ranks passing slices by their tightest margin and near-miss slices by how close their worst condition came to passing, in one rule.
